widgets.label: Rules
rows: Draw, charge one card as mana, summon/cast, attack
Each player starts with 5 shields; broken shields go to your hand
Attack the opponent directly when they have no shields left
Creatures with Blocker can stop an attack
Light, Water, Darkness, Fire, Nature: mana must include the card's colour

widgets.text: Count the opponent's untapped blockers before attacking, and keep a removal spell for their biggest creature.
